|arg= local

|gr1= GUI Control

|descr= Returns if a control on the currently active user dialog is enabled. Disabled controls cannot be focused. Read [[Arma: GUI Configuration]] for more information about user dialogs and controls.

|s1= [[ctrlEnabled]] idc

|p1= idc: [[Number]] - control's IDC

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if the control is enabled, [[false]] if not

|s2= [[ctrlEnabled]] controlName

|p21= controlName: [[Control]]

|r2= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if the control is enabled, [[false]] if not

|x1= <sqf>
if !(ctrlEnabled 100) then
{
	ctrlEnable [100, true];
};
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_enabled = ctrlEnabled _control;</sqf>

|seealso= [[ctrlEnable]]
